cad.revisionStatus: workspace URL; immutable CAD revision not yet available
cad.verification: Exact selected URL matches official team release. Complete user GLB root/subassemblies inspected; geometry hash pins the upload, not an invented immutable Onshape revision.

primarySources.purpose: Official team release identifies season, robot, exact CAD link and final competition changes.
Official team robot page corroborates robot, season and released CAD/code.

code.role: Parameter and mechanism evidence only; not copied simulator implementation. Code license does not establish CAD rights.

redistribution.note: No CAD clearance inferred from official code license. Preserve owner-authorized noncommercial v1 publication policy; source export still required.

unmeasured: Real intake/fire throughput and calibrated hit distribution

partialGeometry.scope: Intake/hopper subassembly only; not a complete robot.
partialGeometry.use: Retained only as an ignored research input. Not registered, rendered, or copied into production. No simulation implementation copied.
partialGeometry.missing: Chassis, four complete swerve modules, shooter drum, hood and complete assembly mates/pivots. Source documentation describes procedural replacements for these; those are not accepted as real CAD.

sourceParameters.classification: Official code configuration; not CAD measurements or guaranteed measured real-world performance. Coordinate conversion and source unit conventions require complete CAD verification.

moduleSourceLocationsMetres.sourceUnits: ±9.75 inches X and ±12.5 inches Y in WPILib; not yet mapped into Jamesim axes

slideEndpointDifferenceMetres.derivation: 13.55−6.4 inches; not independently verified as final mechanical stroke

climber.evidence: Official release author, posts5–6: removed before first event and remained absent.

movingShotPrediction.evidence: ShootMoveLUT.calculate returns distance-only result before commented velocity/latency prediction. Do not infer enabled prediction from filename.

hopperAgitation.evidence: AgitateIntake.execute: after650ms of ready shooting, pulls slide toward MIN_AGITATION_POSITION2 (6.3in); on end restores SLIDE_DROP. Experimental oscillation code is commented out.

uploadedGeometry.verification: Numeric binary concatenation; GLB magic/version/header length and uploaded SHA-256 matched. Uploaded scripts read as data, never executed.

preparation.sourceTransform: Native +Z intake and native +Z/up hood release map to simulator -X; rotate Y -90deg, Y offset -0.223m. Fixed reversed shooter uses existing yawOffset PI.
preparation.moduleAxles: Each source module wheel axle normalized independently; all module mounts rigid.
preparation.supplementalGeometry: Four bumper padding bars, source CAD omits bumpers. Official code .76x.92m outer footprint; estimated .0635m padding thickness clears source frame on both axes; not passed off as team-supplied CAD.
preparation.displayOverride: Exterior S26-IN-P322 at24% opacity for hopper visibility; source export material was opaque.
preparation.intakeArticulation: P301/P315 rack/carriage, P302 upper roller, P322 polycarbonate U-wrap and P330 cap translate together. P303 lower kicker and P311 supports stay fixed down.
preparation.simplification: Topology-preserving 2mm source / 4mm merged reduction. No simplifySloppy. P322/P330 original tessellation protected including 524 cap triangles.

hoodReference.evidence: Main shaft and final hood-roller radius define the release tangent; actual projectile/rendered tangent tested at distinct hub/pass elevations.

preparation.normalOwnership: Recomputed NORMAL data is assigned to a cloned per-primitive accessor, avoiding mutation if future sources share it. This upload had no shared NORMAL accessors; all5625834 decoded position/normal/color/index scalar values are identical before/after this guard. Binary serialization order changes the hash without changing geometry.

estimates.slideExplanation: Boot encoder zero, source13.55in drop value, sloped rack and required floor-roller clearance. Absolute stroke and hood reference mapping remain fitted; no immutable mate limits supplied.
estimates.movingShotsReason: Official ShootMoveLUT returns distance-only before commented predictor.
